title: Desenvolvedor(a) Node.Js Pleno
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end (Node.js e Java) para fazer parte do nosso movimento. Essa pessoa será responsável por desenvolver soluções robustas e escaláveis, atuando de ponta a ponta no ciclo de desenvolvimento, com forte interação com stakeholders e foco em qualidade técnica e inovação.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Analisar e compreender as necessidades e requisitos dos clientes, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com equipes internas e stakeholders para implementar soluções técnicas adequadas e inovadoras.
  • Desenvolver e documentar código de alta qualidade, seguindo padrões e melhores práticas de programação, utilizando frameworks e bibliotecas apropriadas para atender aos requisitos do projeto.
  • Participar do processo completo de desenvolvimento, desde o planejamento e análise até a programação, testes e implantação, garantindo a entrega de soluções funcionais e escaláveis.
  • Colaborar com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e gerentes de projeto, compartilhando conhecimento e ajudando a solucionar problemas e encontrar soluções inovadoras.
  • Comunicar-se efetivamente com os membros da equipe e stakeholders do projeto, fornecendo atualizações de progresso, discutindo desafios e soluções.
  • Participar de revisões de código e reuniões de equipe, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos e práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as tendências do setor e desenvolvimentos tecnológicos, aplicando esse conhecimento no aprimoramento das soluções e na promoção da inovação contínua.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Domínio sólido da linguagem de programação Node.js (TypeScript), com experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos em ambientes empresariais.
  • Conhecimento e experiência com frameworks e bibliotecas Node.js populares, como Express, Koa, NestJS, Mocha, Jest e outras.
  • Familiaridade com desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando HTML, CSS, TypeScript/JavaScript e AJAX.
  • Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de dados como MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle ou SQL Server, e habilidades em SQL e modelagem de dados.
  • Conhecimento de práticas e padrões de desenvolvimento de software, como SOLID, design patterns e metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban).
  • Habilidade em escrever e executar testes unitários e de integração, utilizando ferramentas como Mocha, Jest ou similares.
  • Familiaridade com IDEs como Visual Studio Code ou WebStorm e sistemas de controle de versão como Git.
  • Conhecimento de práticas de segurança e conformidade no desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência com integração de APIs e serviços de terceiros via REST, SOAP ou gRPC.
  • Capacidade de analisar e solucionar problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade, aplicando técnicas de otimização e monitoramento.


Você irá se destacar se:

  • Tiver vivência com práticas de DevOps, CI/CD e containerização com Docker/Kubernetes.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Senior Studio Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Senior Studio Specialist at JoVE , you will drive the operational excellence of our in-house creative studio. You will execute and oversee project execution, optimize workflows, and introduce AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands the full creative production lifecycle and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment - a love for science is a plus!


Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and coordinate the execution of creative projects from brief to final delivery
  • Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope.
  • Track the day-to-day progress of projects in the pipeline, follow up on deadlines, flag delays, and ensure workload distribution supports on-time delivery.
  • Define and track KPIs, deadlines, and performance metrics to ensure smooth production cycles
  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to translate business objectives into actionable creative plans
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine briefs and propose effective design solutions
  • Create and edit high-quality video assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, and brand awareness efforts.
  • Design, document, and continuously improve studio workflows and cross-functional processes
  • Ensure brand consistency and creative quality standards across all deliverables
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency
  • Lead the integration of AI technologies into creative workflows, including automation, asset generation, project tracking, and quality optimization


Requirements:

  • 5–7 years of experience in creative production, studio coordination, or motion graphics environments
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent creative projects while ensuring quality and on-time delivery
  • Strong experience supporting and improving production workflows within creative teams
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers and balance workloads effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana (or similar platforms)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to improve production efficiency and creative output
  • Strong attention to detail and quality control across all stages of the creative process
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle (briefing, design, review, revisions, final delivery)


Why Join JoVE?

  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Senior Java Developer (Frontend-Focused Tech Lead)

title: Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

description:

Along with our partner, we are seeking a UX/UI Designer for a short-term contract (5–6 weeks at a part-time capacity) to support the design and evolution of a touch-first iPad application used by laboratory scientists to control equipment and analyze data in real time. The product is designed for non-expert users in lab environments and prioritizes speed, clarity, and reproducibility over visual complexity.


This engagement has two primary goals: defining UX for new feature development and supporting the adoption of updated iOS design guidelines.


Scope of Work:

New Feature Wireframes

You will define wireframes and UX flows for new features prior to development, ensuring alignment between product and engineering teams. These include:

  • A new navigation hub for multiple software modules, including clear handling of licensed vs. unlicensed states
  • A time-series data acquisition feature with configuration, live feedback, and playback for multi-dimensional datasets
  • Two new image analysis modules with consistent flows for launch, controls, results visualization, and save/discard actions
  • Enhancements to an existing analysis module to support additional configurations
  • A data export feature supporting multiple formats and destinations with error handling


iOS Design System Adoption

  • Review existing screens against updated iOS Human Interface Guidelines
  • Identify required updates for custom controls such as overlays, sliders, selectors, and timelines
  • Propose adaptations to align with new system design patterns while maintaining a professional, lab-focused interface
  • Ensure new designs are aligned with updated platform standards from the start


Expected Deliverables:

  • Annotated low- to mid-fidelity wireframes for all new feature flows, approved by the product
  • Design assessment and recommendations for updated iOS design system adoption
  • Final design files delivered in a format usable by the iOS development team


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years of experience as a UI/UX designer with robust experience designing for iPad applications.
  • Apple Platform Mastery: Deep familiarity with Apple HIG specifically for iPad , including expert use of split views, sidebars, popovers, and touch-target optimization.
  • iOS 26 Familiarity: Working knowledge of the Liquid Glass design system, including navigation bars, sheets, and modal presentations under the new paradigm.
  • Wireframing & Tools: Senior-level experience in producing annotated, implementation-ready wireframes using tools such as Figma or Sketch .
  • Scientific UI Experience: Experience designing interfaces where data precision and reproducibility are prioritized; prior work with medical, clinical, or industrial apps is a strong plus.


Team Fit & Work Style:

  • Ability to work from written requirements without dedicated UX research support
  • Self-directed and comfortable working in small teams
  • Comfortable working within established design systems rather than creating new visual languages
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken
  • Experience working in distributed remote teams and async environments


Nice to Have:

  • Experience in laboratory, life sciences, or medical software
  • Experience working with design systems within the Apple ecosystem


Engagement: Short-term contract, 5–6 weeks at a part-time capacity (80 hours per month) with PST work hours overlap.


Timeline: Project kick-off scheduled for early May

description:
Are you passionate about building enterprise grade software applications that people depend on? Do you care that your work makes life better for people around the world? 


We’re building a Latam based fullstack software engineering team to scale and enhance our award winning cloud-based educational technology platform. After establishing a strong product with a fully remote U.S. team while 2xing revenue year over year, we’re now looking for the inaugural elite members to build and grow our Latam team. 


Consider this a unique opportunity to work with a U.S. based product company of top engineers and product executives, make an impact by improving education, and be part of a rocket ship!


About You


  • Versatile and hands-on doer, starter attitude
  • Empathetic and humble, you are respectful, optimistic, have the capacity to commit to disagreement when needed, and take ownership
  • Ability and willingness to work cross-functionally
  • Experience working with non-tech colleagues


Core Responsibilities


  • Develop PHP based features end to end
  • Address complex refactoring challenges in legacy PHP systems
  • Debug and repair broken or overly buggy code
  • Contribute to code reviews, QA, and an Agile development process
  • Participate in architectural planning and technical roadmapping


Must Have


  • 3+ years building full-stack applications with PHP backend

  • Experience with SQL
  • API development expertise
  • Collaborative mindset with ability to work independently
  • Growth-oriented approach


Nice to Have


  • Modern PHP framework knowledge such as Laravel

  • Cloud deployments experience
  • Test automation experience
  • Microservices development experience
  • Educational software or SaaS platforms expertise
  • Data integration expertise
  • Enthusiastic about learning and teaching others


What You’ll Get


An opportunity for uncommonly fast career growth. Work in a supportive, collaborative, and creative environment where you can thrive personally and professionally


  • Above market salary in local market
  • Flexible PTO and vacation policy
  • Flexible, family-friendly schedule to help you achieve work/life balance
  • Exposure to the US education technology industry
  • Exposure to industry C-suite executives and valuable networking experiences
  • Team up alongside a group of down to earth people looking to level up and build something big
  • Full-time remote position


We are an equal opportunity employer. No recruiters, please.


— FAQ —


What would be my career trajectory?


As a company, we have a very flat hierarchy. Your direct manager will be the VP of Engineering and his boss the Co-founder and Chief Product Officer. If you care about building experience by cultivating high-functioning teams, releasing great software, accomplishing goals, and learning new things, this is the right place for you. If you care about titles and meetings and titles, this is not the right place for you. Our belief is there will always be “the next job” so push yourself to learn and grow in the time you are here.


What is work like here?


We’re a Series B funded education technology platform. Think of us as a startup but without all of the early stage business and funding risks. It also means no corporate atmosphere with a strict dress code, and no stuffy bureaucracy to drown out your ideas. We value every team member and if we hire you, it’s because we think you can do great things with us. We aren’t going to sugar-coat everything. We have our challenges like every other business. Where we separate ourselves is having the willingness and motivation to take our challenges head-on before they grow.

title: Backend Cloud Engineer — AWS Serverless (Remote)
description:
About EverUp

We’re a UK startup making gift-card shopping rewarding. Our mobile app (React Native) and web (React) run on a serverless AWS backend. We’re hiring a Backend Cloud Engineer to evolve and maintain the APIs, databases, and services that power payments, wallet, rewards, and near-real-time features.

The role

You’ll work across our event-driven, serverless stack to maintain and evolve production systems. That means adding features, fixing bugs, improving performance and cost, tightening security, and raising reliability—while collaborating closely with Mobile/Web.

What you’ll do

  • Maintain and evolve AWS Lambda microservices behind Amazon API Gateway (HTTP/REST & WebSocket) and AWS IoT Core ; implement authentication/authorization via Cognito User Pools (JWT) and Lambda authorizers for REST/HTTP.
  • Maintain and optimize data models and access patterns in DynamoDB and MySQL (RDS); handle indexes, migrations, and query performance.
  • Maintain asynchronous workflows using SQS/SNS (idempotency, DLQs, retries) and keep observability healthy with CloudWatch metrics/logs and alarms.
  • Maintain and improve our IaC (AWS SAM/CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, and environment promotions.
  • Integrate and support third-party services used for payments, open banking, notifications, fraud/risk, analytics and support tooling.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, drive RCAs, and implement preventive fixes and runbooks.
  • Uphold security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secret management, input validation, auditability).

Tech you’ll touch

AWS Lambda, API Gateway (REST/WebSocket), Cognito, DynamoDB, RDS MySQL, SQS/SNS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation/SAM, EC2, ECS, plus fintech/comms integrations (Open Banking/PSP, Gift Cards, Analytics, Messaging, Support, and Risk assessment tools).

Must-haves

  • 8+ years building/maintaining production backends; 4+ years with AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB).
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js; strong REST API fundamentals and event-driven patterns.
  • Solid SQL/NoSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning).
  • Experience maintaining IaC (SAM/CloudFormation) and CI/CD (Code Pipeline).
  • Security-first mindset and practical debugging/troubleshooting chops (OWASP).
  • WebSocket/API Gateway connection management and real-time features.
  • Payments/fintech and fraud/risk integrations.
  • Observability practices (dashboards, tracing, log correlation) and SLOs.
  • Elastic Beanstalk familiarity and data pipelines/warehousing exposure.

How we work

Remote-first within UK time zone, startup-paced, with high ownership. We value clean code, small safe changes, and excellent operability.

Hiring process

title: Arquiteto de Soluções em Nuvem e IA
description:
Sobre  a Oportunidade  


Estamos buscando um Arquiteto de Soluções em Nuvem para se juntar ao time de transformação do Ad Intelligence, com foco no design e implementação de soluções orientadas por IA para segmentação e classificação de publicidade em TV. Este papel combina responsabilidade arquitetural com execução técnica hands-on, incluindo provisionamento de infraestrutura, configuração de DevOps/MLOps e colaboração próxima com times de engenharia e ciência de dados. Você será responsável pelo design de sistemas de ponta a ponta para ingestão de vídeo, processamento, armazenamento, implantação de modelos e serviços de inteligência de conteúdo, garantindo confiabilidade, segurança, performance e alinhamento com a estratégia de produto.  


Principais Responsabilidades  


Design de Arquitetura de Ponta a Ponta: Definir e ser responsável pela arquitetura em nuvem (Azure, GCP ou similar) para ingestão de vídeo em larga escala, processamento, pipelines de IA e plataformas de inteligência de conteúdo. 


Engenharia de Infraestrutura em Nuvem: Construir e configurar infraestrutura escalável (compute, storage, networking, serviços serverless, containers) utilizando ferramentas de IaC para suportar workloads de vídeo e ML. 


Gestão de DevOps & Pipelines CI/CD: Implementar e manter CI/CD, testes automatizados, observabilidade e pipelines de deploy para dados, ML e serviços backend. 


MLOps & Implantação de Modelos: Colaborar com cientistas de dados para operacionalizar modelos de IA/ML, garantindo eficiência no treinamento, inferência, monitoramento e gestão de ciclo de vida. 


Integração: Definir padrões de integração para pipelines de dados, APIs e serviços nativos de nuvem para permitir escalabilidade global. 


Liderança Técnica: Orientar times de engenharia e ciência de dados sobre melhores práticas e padrões arquiteturais. 


Conformidade & Segurança: Garantir aderência aos princípios de IA Responsável, GDPR e políticas internas de proteção de dados. 


Otimização de Performance & Custos: Avaliar continuamente e otimizar performance do sistema, escalabilidade, confiabilidade e eficiência de custos em nuvem em todos os componentes. 


Engajamento com Stakeholders: Traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e comunicar decisões arquiteturais de forma clara. 


Requisitos  


O candidato ideal combina profunda expertise técnica em arquitetura de soluções em nuvem (incluindo GenAI) com fortes habilidades de liderança e comunicação. Destaca-se na criação de sistemas escaláveis e seguros e atua bem em ambientes colaborativos e dinâmicos. 


Experiência Profissional:  


  • Mínimo de 5 a 7 anos de experiência em funções de arquitetura de soluções em nuvem, preferencialmente em ambientes de mídia, tecnologia ou orientados por IA.  
  • Experiência prática significativa na implantação de sistemas em produção em Azure ou GCP com foco em escalabilidade e confiabilidade.  
  • Experiência com integração, transformação, armazenamento e análise de dados, incluindo workflows de vídeo (ingestão, processamento, transformação e análise).  
  • Experiência comprovada na implementação de pipelines CI/CD, testes automatizados e automação de infraestrutura em produtos reais.  
  • Experiência colaborando com times de ciência de dados para implantação, otimização e monitoramento de modelos de machine learning em produção.  
  • Experiência em design ou operação de sistemas distribuídos de alta performance para workloads de dados ou mídia.  
  • Experiência trabalhando com times de produto, engenharia e analytics para entrega de soluções ponta a ponta.  


Competências Técnicas e Funcionais:  


  • Capacidade de projetar arquiteturas escaláveis, seguras e orientadas a vídeo e IA usando Azure, GCP ou similares.  
  • Conhecimento de frameworks arquiteturais, padrões de documentação e modelos de referência para sistemas em larga escala.  
  • Proficiência em Infrastructure as Code (ex: Terraform ou equivalente) para provisionamento e automação de infraestrutura em nuvem.  
  • Forte capacidade de construir e manter pipelines CI/CD, workloads containerizados e processos automatizados de deploy.  
  • Experiência em operacionalização de modelos de ML, monitoramento de modelos e suporte a fluxos de trabalho de ciência de dados (MLOps).  
  • Expertise em design de sistemas robustos, modulares e escaláveis, incluindo microservices e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.  
  • Forte entendimento de segurança de dados, compliance, GDPR e princípios de IA Responsável.  
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas para conectar times técnicos e de negócio.  
  • Entendimento de requisitos da indústria de mídia (video workflows, metadados de conteúdo e compliance) é um diferencial importante.  


Formação e Certificações:  


  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Cloud Computing ou área relacionada.  
  • Certificações em nuvem como Azure Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect ou similares são altamente valorizadas. 


Idiomas  


  • Inglês fluente, como requisito obrigatório 
  • Espanhol e Francês fluente é desejável

title: Clinical Study Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.


Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities

  • Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.
  • Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.
  • Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.
  • Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.
  • Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.
  • Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.
  • In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.g., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.
  • Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.
  • Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.
  • Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively
  • Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.
  • Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.
  • Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.
  • Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.
  • Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.
  • Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.e. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.
  • Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.
  • Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites.
  • Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required
  • Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct
  • Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated
  • Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.
  • Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.
  • Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.


Education and Experience

  • Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management.
  • Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.g. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).
  • Experience managing clinical project team personnel.
  • Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.
  • Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.
  • Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.
  • Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.
  • Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.
  • Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.
  • Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.
  • Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.
  • Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.
  • Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).
  • .
  • Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.
  • Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.
  • Must be fluent in English

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Consultor SAP FI – Suporte & Sustentação
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

O profissional atuará com foco principal em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade, aderência às regras locais (Brasil e LATAM) e alinhamento com diretrizes globais. Também participará de projetos, melhorias e iniciativas de evolução do sistema, conforme demanda do negócio.


  • Contrato: Vaga temporária - Duração de 1 mês, ideal para profissionais disponíveis imediatamente, atuando com SAP FI!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Atuar prioritariamente na sustentação e suporte do SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade do ambiente e atendimento às demandas do negócio.
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes e requisições relacionadas aos processos financeiros.
  • Apoiar as áreas de Finanças e Controladoria na correta utilização do sistema.
  • Garantir aderência às regras fiscais brasileiras e requisitos LATAM.
  • Realizar análises funcionais detalhadas e propor soluções alinhadas às melhores práticas.
  • Configurar, testar e validar soluções no SAP FI.
  • Apoiar processos como: Fechamento contábil mensal (Month-End Close); Integrações financeiras; Especificidades fiscais brasileiras; Integrações com outros módulos SAP.
  • Identificar melhorias contínuas em processos e parametrizações.
  • Elaborar documentação funcional, especificações e evidências de testes.
  • Participar de projetos de implementação, rollouts, melhorias e upgrades SAP.
  • Conduzir workshops para levantamento de requisitos quando necessário.
  • Validar e testar especificidades Brasil e LATAM durante atualizações do sistema.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de CSV para garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Assegurar qualidade e integridade dos dados financeiros no SAP.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente profissionais juniores, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.
  • Atuar como interface entre Brasil/LATAM e Headquarter para temas relacionados a SAP FI.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Criar roteiros para Reels de Reflexão (60-120s) com hooks virais para Instagram e TikTok
  • Escrever roteiros para Vlogs semanais no YouTube (20 min) em formato documentário
  • Produzir textos para Carrosséis de Dados (10 slides) com narrativa baseada em dados do CNJ
  • Escrever Artigos Analíticos longos para LinkedIn (tom de cronista, sem emojis, sem links)

title: IBM ESS Storage Support Engineer
description:
We are seeking a contractor to provide day-to-day remote support for an ageing 4.5 PB IBM ESS storage environment supporting HPC clusters within a data center setting. The engagement is focused on operational support, incident resolution, system health monitoring, filesystem support, and critical escalation coverage outside standard business hours. The IBM ESS Storage Support Engineer will be responsible for the ongoing support and maintenance of the storage environment. This includes monitoring, troubleshooting, break-fix support, routine health checks, and performance tuning of IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment. The role also requires participation in weekend on-call support for critical Severity 1 issues.


Location:

Brazil, Mexico


Responsibilities:

  • Provide day-to-day remote operational support for a 4.5 PB IBM ESS storage environment
  • Monitor system health, alerts, capacity, and overall storage performance
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve storage-related incidents and service issues
  • Provide break-fix support and coordinate escalations where required
  • Support IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment
  • Assist with tuning and troubleshooting of parallel filesystem workloads
  • Carry out routine health checks and preventative maintenance activities
  • Support SAN-related troubleshooting, including fabric connectivity and multipathing
  • Participate in weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents only
  • Maintain clear documentation of incidents, resolutions, and operational recommendations


What we expect:

  • Proven hands-on experience with IBM ESS storage systems
  • Experience supporting IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in HPC environments
  • Good understanding of parallel filesystem workloads and HPC job patterns
  • Experience with SAN environments, including Brocade or Cisco fabrics, zoning, LUN masking, and multipathing
  • Strong Linux administration skills, particularly RHEL and SUSE
  • Working knowledge of the AIX command line
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken
  • Availability to work during EST business hours
  • Ability to provide weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents


Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting petabyte-scale storage environments
  • Background in data centre or scientific computing environments
  • Experience with performance tuning of GPFS / Spectrum Scale
  • Familiarity with supporting ageing infrastructure and maintaining operational stability
  • Experience in incident management and root cause analysis


We offer:

  • Highly competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours
  • Continuous education, mentoring, and professional development programs
  • Strong management and tech expertise
  • 12-month contract with possible extension

title: Gerente de segurança da informação
description:
O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG.


Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais.


Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro.


Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas!

Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira!


Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.


Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional.


Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua.


Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Principais atividades:


  • Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização.
  • Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros.
  • Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos.
  • Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS).
  • Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança.
  • Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura.
  • Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais.
  • Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura.
  • Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral.
  • Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos.
  • Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores.
  • Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins
  • Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos
  • Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR)


Conhecimento específicos:


  • Políticas de segurança
  • Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social.
  • Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos
  • Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização
  • Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Informações da vaga:


Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido)

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: Segunda á sexta

Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. title: Full-Time Project Lead
description:
About Us

BlueTuskr is a rapidly growing full-service digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. Our team is highly collaborative and committed to delivering exceptional results for our clients, helping them grow and scale their businesses.


As we continue to expand, we’re looking for a full-time Project Lead to join our team and oversee the day-to-day pipeline of client projects. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced agency environment and enjoys bringing structure, organization, and momentum to complex marketing initiatives.


What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be responsible for managing the lifecycle of multiple client projects, ensuring timelines are met, teams stay aligned, and deliverables meet client expectations. This role sits at the center of our internal operations, coordinating efforts across design, content, strategy, and paid media teams while maintaining clear communication with stakeholders.


The ideal candidate has:

  • 3-5 years of project management experience
  • 1-2 years of marketing agency experience ( some e-commerce experience is preferred).
  • A strong understanding of marketing workflows, including content creation, paid media, SEO, and creative production.
  • Proficiency in project management tools, especially Asana.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • A problem-solving mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • The ability to multitask and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Project Planning & Execution (50% of your time)

  • Develop and manage detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets.
  • Break down projects into actionable tasks and assign responsibilities across teams.
  • Ensure tasks are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with client goals.
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential roadblocks.
  • Monitor progress, making adjustments to plans as needed to stay on track.


2. Team Coordination & Communication (30% of your time)

  • Serve as the main point of contact between internal teams and clients.
  • Facilitate regular check-ins, stand-ups, and progress meetings.
  • Ensure seamless communication and collaboration between departments (design, content, strategy, etc.).
  • Provide clear direction and ensure team members understand priorities and deadlines.
  • Foster a positive, productive environment and help remove any obstacles.


3. Performance Monitoring & Reporting (20% of your time)

  • Track project performance, including key metrics like timeline adherence, budget management, and client satisfaction.
  • Prepare and present progress reports to leadership and clients.
  • Analyze project data to identify areas for improvement in efficiency and processes.
  • Contribute to refining workflows and improving project management methodologies.


Salary

The starting salary for this position is between $3000 and $3500 USD per month, depending on experience.


SO, if you are a highly motivated and skilled Project Manager with experience in marketing and e-commerce, AND you’d like to have the opportunity to join a growing marketing agency and be part of an invaluable team, we can’t wait to hear from you!

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description:
About SEW

SEW.ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas , Solar and eMobility industry. As leading #1 SEW.ai platform provide world-class Customer Experience (CX) , Workforce Experience (WX) , Payment Experience (PX) , Intelligent Experience (iX) , Business Experience (BX) and Grid Experience (GX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.

  • 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific

SEW is a global, innovation-driven organization that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning while building solutions that accelerate digital transformation across the Energy and Utilities sector.


Role Summary

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.


The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.


This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.


Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.
  • Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation
  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.


Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.
  • Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.


Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.


Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .
  • Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities.
  • Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector.
  • Demonstrated experience working with SaaS platforms, cloud architectures, and enterprise integrations.
  • Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities.
  • Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations).
  • Ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while influencing global cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30% .


Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.
  • Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

title: GRC Engineer
description:
100% Remote Identity GRC Engineer

Long Term Contract


Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

~6+ years of experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM) operations or IT security administration

Strong experience in access governance and compliance

Hands-on experience running access review campaigns (UAR / PAR)

Experience managing user entitlements, preferably in SAP GRC Access Control

Experience with privileged access management concepts and tools

Familiarity with SAP Firefighter and privileged account governance across ADDS, cloud platforms, and ERP systems

Experience working with auditors or compliance teams

Evidence collection and remediation of audit findings strongly preferred

Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills

Strong attention to detail and operational execution mindset


Day to Day:


Insight Global is looking for a Technical Team Lead – Identity GRC to serve as the hands-on operational engineer responsible for identity governance and compliance execution within their region. This individual will oversee daily execution of access governance controls, ensuring reviews are completed on time, within policy, and with audit-ready documentation. This role partners closely with IT, security, and business stakeholders to mitigate access risks and drive continuous improvement.


Specific Responsibilities:


Access Review Management:

Plan, coordinate, and execute periodic User Access Reviews (UAR) and Privileged Access Reviews (PAR) for critical systems

Notify reviewers, provide access data, track completion, and escalate non-compliance

Segregation of Duties (SoD):

Identify, track, and manage remediation of SoD conflicts

Partner with application owners and Identity GRC Architects to resolve or mitigate risks

Emergency Access Oversight:

Administer and monitor emergency (“firefighter”) access accounts

Ensure approvals are in place and review activity logs for elevated access usage

Privileged Account Governance:

Govern privileged accounts across Active Directory, cloud platforms, and ERP systems

Conduct regular reviews to ensure appropriate access and compliant usage

Audit Support & Evidence Collection:

Compile and maintain audit evidence for all Identity GRC controls

Respond to audit requests and support remediation of identified findings

Automation & Process Improvement:

Identify opportunities to automate manual access review and certification processes

Implement approved automation (e.g., scripting) to improve efficiency and accuracy

Risk Escalation & Reporting:

Escalate high-risk issues or control gaps to the Identity GRC Architect and Senior Director

Provide clear reporting and recommendations for mitigation

description:
Descrição da vaga

Oportunidade para Professor(a) de Inglês – Parceria para Autônomos (PJ/MEI)

Estamos expandindo nosso time e buscamos professores de inglês que queiram atuar como parceiros prestadores de serviços. Se você é um profissional autônomo, possui MEI e busca flexibilidade, essa vaga é para você.


Sobre a Parceria (Modelo MEI):

Trata-se de uma contratação de serviço autônomo (PJ). Não é regime CLT, mas sim uma parceria direta entre profissionais formalizados.

  • Remuneração: O repasse é calculado por aluno.
  • Valor de Referência: R$ 160,00 mensais por aluno (baseado em aulas de 2 horas semanais).

(por volta de 17.5 a 20 reais por hora dependendo do mês).

  • Escalabilidade: Esse valor é variável. O seu ganho mensal dependerá do número de alunos que você assumir e do plano de aulas (carga horária semanal) que cada aluno escolher.


O que buscamos:

\"I’m looking for English teachers who understand that a conversation is better than a textbook.\"


Take your time to read the content below carefully.




*- Particularly looking for organized and adaptable people.*

﻿


Greetings! We believe that English is a living tool, not a set of rules in a book. Our company is built on a 1-on-1 Conversational Methodology that prioritizes real-world fluency over parrot-fashioned memorization.




Here's what we recommend about our *Methodology* .




*Adaptive Correction:* You don’t just interrupt; you adapt to the student’s learning style. You master the \"Art of Correction\"—knowing exactly when to fix a mistake on the spot for immediate growth, or when to let the student finish their thought to maintain their confidence.



*Pattern Recognition:* We don’t just fix one-off errors. We look for the \"Patterns\" of the student’s mistakes. When a pattern emerges, you will design a specific, creative class or exercise to help the student understand and break that pattern permanently.



*Creative Freedom:* While our core is conversational, we value your unique voice. You are encouraged to bring your own methodologies and creative tools into the session, but if the primary focus remains on high-engagement, the students would love it, that’s our suggestion.



*The Selection Process: (For those who want to apply)*


I value clarity and energy above all else. Because we are a conversational-first company, I do not hire based on resumes alone.




*(Not Necessary but PREFERRED) To apply, you SHOULD include a 60-second video introduction with your application.* * The Goal: I want to see your communication style, your presence, and how you explain a complex idea simply.


*The Format:* Don't overthink it—no professional editing required. Just show me who you are as a communicator. You may introduce yourself, or follow any format you feel comfortable with.


Afterwards I will check and decide who gets a chance at an interview, applicants with an introduction video have a higher chance of getting selected.




Vantagens:

  • Autonomia na prestação dos serviços.
  • Possibilidade de aumentar o faturamento conforme a entrada de novos alunos.
  • Sem burocracia de vínculo empregatício.

description:

About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:
We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.
